description: Museum-owned and airworthy; regularly flown to airshows and for ride experiences but hangared at and displayed by the museum; FAA registry current with N744CG registered to Champaign Aviation Museum serial 44-28866 and YEAR-MFR 1944; postwar airtanker restored by the Peddycord Foundation with first post-restoration flight 30 October 2004 and acquired by the museum December 2008
aliases: B-25N; Mitchell; N744CG; B25; B25J; B25N

description: Long-running rebuild to flying condition using parts from several airframes so it is a genuine 44-85813 identity but not an intact original airframe; built by Lockheed-Vega as a B-17G-110-VE and delivered May 1945; never saw combat; leased to Curtiss-Wright and converted to the model 299Z engine testbed then an airtanker; crashed in Brunswick County North Carolina in April 1980 and the remains were bought by the museum in 2005
aliases: Flying Fortress; N3154S; N6694C; c/n 8722; 299Z; B17; B17G

description: Ex-water-bomber acquired by the museum in 2008 and kept outdoors for years; moved inside when the new hangar opened in 2025; restoration has not yet started; photographed at Grimes Field still wearing its Canadian firebomber registration C-GHLX
aliases: A-26B; Invader; N381EC; C-GHLX; A26; A26C; A26B

description: Delivered to the US Navy in 1955 and served aboard USS Lexington and USS Roosevelt; donated to the museum January 2019; FAA registry current with N778SR registered to the museum as model TF-1 serial 136778 and YEAR-MFR 1955 on an experimental exhibition certificate
